This is the model this app's "Default vision model" setting used during development/testing, so its own vision capability was verified end-to-end before migrating, not just inferred from the sibling entries: pulled the real repo (7.0GB main file + its 175MB mmproj-*.gguf projector, both auto-paired by Ollama's hf.co/ pull), then confirmed via `ollama show` — Capabilities: tools, completion, vision, audio, 11.9B params (matches "12B" here). Google's own official GGUF repo — confirmed live: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf, arch "gemma4", 25.2B total params, 262144 ctx — "A4B" (~4B active) matches this entry's "3.8B active" exactly.
Google's own official GGUF repo — confirmed live: google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf, arch "gemma4", 30.7B total params, 262144 ctx — matches this entry exactly.

Vision-capable — Vicuna-7B fine-tuned with a CLIP ViT-L vision encoder. The standard, most widely-used size for this family; noticeably lighter than gemma4:12b for image-attachment replies. Sourced from Hugging Face — confirmed live: second-state/Llava-v1.6-Vicuna-7B-GGUF, arch "llama", 6.74B params, 4096 ctx, with a Q4_K_M main file plus its own -mmproj-model-f16.gguf projector in the same repo. Ollama's hf.co/ pull syntax was confirmed (via a real pull + `ollama show`, not just repo inspection) to auto-detect and pull a same-repo "mmproj"-named file alongside the tagged one and keep vision working. "Q4_K_M" is llama.cpp's own mix label, not a real GGML type by itself — the underlying [Q4_K, Q6_K] pair is recorded in quantizations instead.

Mistral AI's own official GGUF repo (not a community re-quant) — confirmed live via the Hugging Face API: mistralai/Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512-GGUF, arch "mistral3" (the same decoder architecture this app's own from-scratch runtime, matricxon, already implements), 3,429,006,336 total params, 262144 ctx. The Q4_K_M file is a real, verified sibling of the repo (2.15GB via a HEAD request's Content-Length) — not assumed from the repo name alone. The repo also carries a BF16-only vision mmproj file, but with no quantized counterpart for Q4_K_M, so vision pairing isn't claimed here (unlike the gemma4:12b/LLaVA entries, which had that verified end-to-end).

embedding_models.note: nomic-ai's own official GGUF repo (not a community re-quant) — confirmed live: arch "nomic-bert", 137M params, 2048 ctx, 768-dim embeddings, Capabilities: embedding. A real /api/embed call returned a correct 768-dim vector. This is the default (see EMBEDDING_MODEL in app/config.py) — higher retrieval quality than the lighter MiniLM entry, at roughly 6x the parameter count.

Highest-downloaded (402k) community GGUF conversion of sentence-transformers' all-MiniLM-L6-v2 — confirmed live: arch "bert", 22.6M params, 512 ctx, 384-dim embeddings, Capabilities: embedding. A real /api/embed call returned a correct 384-dim vector. Offered as the lighter/faster alternative, not the default.
